description: Reduces a signal to eight bits and lets you invert or clear any of them one at a time

params.text: Leaves that bit alone when up, clears it when centred, and inverts it when down

inputs.text: The signal to be broken into bits

outputs.text: The signal put back together from the bits

notes: the signal is reduced to eight bits whatever the switches are set to, so the module always coarsens it.
switch 1 is the smallest bit, worth about 40mV, and switch 8 the largest, worth 5V, so touching switch 8 changes the sound far more than switch 1 does.
-5V maps to a byte of 0 and 5V to a byte of 255, so silence at 0V is a byte of about 128 rather than 0.
